results.description:
It was to be a one-night stand, a one and done. What Marisa Price and Aidan Graywolf discover, life never plays fair—not when there are secrets to be uncovered.

Marisa Price's academic career soars when she finds a trove of secret letters dating to the 1600s. Letters that document the love affair between Shakespeare and a Black woman. What Marisa didn't expect was Aidan Graywolf and the memories of three magical days in his bed—nor the daughter that resulted from their passion. Determined to avoid romantic entanglements, Marisa embraces single parenthood as she writes the story of Isabelle and Shakespeare.

Aidan Graywolf never forgot the woman who shattered the icicles around his heart. It was to be a one-night stand, a one and done. What he didn't expect was Marisa Price and one night became a weekend that changed his life forever. When he learns their night together gave him a child, he will stop at nothing to claim his daughter, and Marisa's love.
 
Can a marriage of convenience and an unforgettable night of passion help this pair overcome the impediments to true love? Or did Shakespeare get it all wrong?
